title: Ascend vs CUDA: Same Qwen3-8B Model，Same Seed，15% Token Agreement
author: Ruitong
content:
We ran Qwen3-8B on Ascend (DashScope) and NVIDIA A40 (CUDA) with identical parameters across 61 prompts. The result: only 15% top-1 token agreement. 98% of prompts diverged.

Results:

  • Top-1 token agreement: 15.02%
  • Prompts diverging: 60/61 (98.4%)
  • Top-5 overlap: 20.92%

For comparison, A40 vs RTX 6000 Ada (same CUDA stack) diverged on ~19% of prompts. A40 vs Ascend: 98%.

Full analysis: https://ruitong.io/posts/ascend-vs-cuda-equivalence
Code: https://github.com/loopeywho/ruitong

For context， the author notes that A40 vs RTX 6000 Ada (both on the same CUDA stack) diverged on only ~19% of prompts， suggesting the Ascend-CUDA gap is substantially larger than intra-CUDA variance.
